subject: Why does observeEvent handle "eventExpr" differently if inputs are provided as a list?

messages.author: 9e3cd2bfbb16b85b
messages.subject: Why does observeEvent handle "eventExpr" differently if inputs are provided as a list?
parts:
In the example below, the log reads "pressed A" only when the A button is pressed. However, the log reads "pressed B or C" immediately upon application startup, regardless of whether button B or C is actually pressed. The only difference is that input$a is referenced explicitly, and input$b and input$c are referenced through an lapply. (This is a simplified version of my real case where button_ids is large and generated dynamically, which is why I use lapply instead of explicit reference).

Any ideas?

Thanks!


library(shiny)

button_ids <- list("b", "c")

shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(
    fluidRow(
      actionButton("a", "A"),
      actionButton("b", "B"),
      actionButton("c", "C")
    )),
  
  server = function(input, output, session) {
    
    observeEvent({
      input$a
      }, {
      cat("pressed A\n")
    })
    
    observeEvent({
      lapply(button_ids, function(xx) input[[xx]])
    }, {
    cat("pressed B or C\n")
    })
  })
